verdict.rationale: The docs say Devin for Terminal runs in your local environment for quick fixes and interactive coding, so some agent execution can happen on your own machine. Longer tasks are handed off to cloud Devin, and the VPN, macOS and Windows VM docs all describe Devin's own hosted workspace, not infrastructure you run. Missing for 10: self-hosted deployment of the full agent infrastructure, container-based deployment, running on customer-owned VMs, and any independent corroboration.
